activity_summary: Mistress Ansell set the loaf a finger and a half short of the notch, at a penny, and not on a pan. You did not argue it. She called forty lines a length and not yet a play, and she would not give a verdict without a plot. The board was three pence. Alse was not given a side. The jig stayed out of the kitchen. The comedy is back from Field's.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the loaf, refused a verdict, and kept the three pence.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named forty lines and a sitting-down, and would not tell the plot.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked after a shirt, and was not given a side.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Compared the walk to a shuttle, and went to his door.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Kept the stool, and declined the end of the loaf.
